claims.assertion: Swaruu said social conditioning can turn people against contactees, while authorities may target those sharing sensitive information.

claims.qualifiers: She acknowledged sources that argue Nibiru should exist.

claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 attributed the apparent missing solar-system mass to a gravitational balance point formed by three smaller bodies, not a large planet.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9)
